comparison.objective: Assemble and bayonet-lock a mini chopper, then pulse it once; candidate adjusts and locks a damper before guarded test cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-on-pin insertion, top alignment, bimanual bayonet twist, and button press versus recessed hex-bit engagement, separate collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and torque-controlled relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Blade seated, top locked, exactly one valid pulse, button released, and arms returned safely; candidate requires two measured non-bottoming stops with retained setting.
comparison.reason: The configure-lock-operate pattern is similar, but appliance assembly/insertion and a binary functional pulse do not test iterative dynamic-response tuning.
